subject: Kitchen block proposal with your core-plus-adapters constraints folded in; Grok video adapter per your October 29 specification; S01-1 example; questions for the execution lane
body:
Your two messages of October 29 are folded in: one provider-neutral core (the shot-direction card plus section 11 KITCHEN, twelve fields, labels drawn from CLIP_SOURCE_PACK), scopes A and B explicit, six adapters as binding tables with operator fields separate, Grok video as route A6 with your request and return list, hybrid lineage as separate linked records, the two Grok Bot clips of October 21 cited by id, path and hash as the route's evidence with the Chief's review attributed as preliminary, originating stills and prompts marked unknown until recovered, the xAI route words recorded as available only on observed controls, the editorial window held constant while native lengths are recorded as returned. The Bellglass line uses Ziggy's October 29 report (audible barking) and keeps the unmoving mouth as the defect; the append to GEMINI_CLIP_SOURCES.txt and the human review is yours.

The head-to-head is written on S01-1 (the mouth on the first word): round 1 each route end to end (still, then clip), round 2 optional with one accepted still into every route; constant across routes: action, preservation criteria, review checks; recorded as different: native length, exposed input slots, observed controls, your struggle line. Gates: Ziggy's go (card item 14), your dispatch decisions, the standing allowances.

Remaining concrete questions for the execution lane, answered at dispatch, not now: (a) which routes expose a second-image or end-frame slot on the surfaces in use; (b) whether the still step can run inside Gemini and Flow in their image modes or needs Grok still or Comfy first; (c) whether Grok Bot shows reference, edit or extension controls, or generation from a still only; (d) the native clip length and audio behaviour each route returns today, since the record's figures are dated.

Also sent to cfa_site_index: the two documents for publication and an append-only delta (items 14 to 17) to the proposed October 28 card. Readiness of the October 9 drop, read by five readers and verified: not today, yes after a small rebuild of the Hon source text; details in the specification's section 7. Nothing generated, uploaded, bought or opened. S02-1 to S02-10 remains the next writing task and is not displaced.

attachments.description: The kitchen block: core, six adapters, migration from the October 9 fields, the head-to-head, reconciliation, readiness, rules (proposal).
Worked example: S01-1 the mouth as one kitchen block with six adapter bindings (proposal).

source: Ziggy's direction in Claude's session, late 2026-10-28 into 2026-10-29 UTC, in substance: the October 9 Gemini drop is the beginning of the structure for flowing storyboard content to a collaborator; tweak the prompt and the photography set-up so other collaborators can use it; prove it with the first two to six seconds generated by each collaborator from the same brief. CFA Nova's operator constraints the same night with his authorization, including Grok video as its own route and the two identified Grok Bot clips of October 21. Ziggy's correction the same night: the Bellglass barking was audible.
